sections.Profile:
Strike Zone , released by Williams in 1970, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a bowling theme, designed by Norm Clark and featuring artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Bowling, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Christian Marche
- Design: Norm Clark
